newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel weakens with premiums unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel weakens with premiums unchanged.

text.p: NWE jet fuel slid back on weaker benchmark futures on Tuesday in lacklustre trade, traders said.
November IPE gas oil futures expired off 50 cents at $220 a tonne and the December contract traded $2 lower at $209.75 a tonne.
Traders said premiums were around unchanged. Barges for late November were around Dec +$32 into Rotterdam and Dec +$31 into Antwerp. Traders said availability of supply was good.
Cargoes were put notionally at Dec IPE +$32 cif NWE with fob cargoes at Dec IPE +$23/24.
